title: Workforce Education and Development, B.S. — Industrial Education Specialization (College of Education)
notes: Historical year built from the archived 2023-24 bulletin (raw HTML, not WebFetch's summary, per the batch's anti-hallucination instruction; the page's own per-semester subtotals -- 14.5+16+17+17+15+15+13.5+13 -- sum to its own printed 'Total Credits 121', confirming internal consistency). Confirmed byte-identical to WFED-2022.json and WFED-2026.json's Suggested Academic Plan course sequence and to the 'Industrial Education Option (43 credits)' Program Requirements course list; identical Entrance-to-Major requirements (3.00 cumulative GPA, 80 documented experience hours). This edition's Program Requirements tab shows the university's Gen Ed policy text was rewritten between the 2022-23 and 2023-24 editions (Foundations/Knowledge Domains breadth figures changed from 3/6/6/6/9-credit domains to a flat 3-credit-each 'Breadth' model plus a restructured 'Integrative Studies'/'Inter-Domain Courses' section) -- this is a university-wide Gen Ed relabeling, not a WFED-specific change, and it doesn't affect any item in this plan since every Gen Ed slot here (Science/Humanities/Mathematics/Social-Behavioral/Art Selection) is already modeled as a generic, un-prefixed placeholder rather than a GN/GH/GQ/GS/GA-tagged slot, per WFED-2026.json's own established convention. Same real prereq-order bug as WFED-2022/2026.json confirmed still present this edition (WFED 441 requires WFED 445, WFED 442 requires WFED 441, yet the printed plan sequences both before WFED 445) -- applied the identical WFED 105 -> WFED 445 -> WFED 441 -> WFED 442 reordering. Genuine per-year finding: the 'Additional Courses: Select one of the following' item (Semester 7) still prints 'STS 245Z' in this edition's course list, same as WFED-2022.json and every later edition through the live 2026 bulletin -- but cross-checking the archived 2023-24 university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/sts/ page shows the actual course was renamed STS 245N as of this edition (identical title 'Globalization, Technology, and Ethics', identical 3 credits, identical department, near-identical description -- only the Gen Ed suffix changed from Z to N), coinciding with the same Gen Ed 'Inter-Domain' terminology overhaul visible in this edition's own Program Requirements text. The WFED program page itself never updated its own printed 'STS 245Z' reference (confirmed still printing the stale code through the live 2026 bulletin, which is WFED-2026.json's own separately-documented finding). Modeled this item using the real current code STS 245N rather than perpetuating the program page's stale reference, alongside the also-real 'LDT 100' (World Technologies and Learning) option this edition's Program Requirements table lists but which WFED-2026.json's own item omits (flagged for the reviewing process, not edited there -- outside this batch's assigned scope).
